shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; node -v; npm -v

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}'; echo "== index.html"; cat index.html; echo "== tsconfig"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "== vite"; cat vite.config.ts; echo "== gitignore"; cat .gitignore; echo "== installed"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls __agent_eval__
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && wc -l references/*.md rules/*.md && sed -n '1,80p' references/package-routing.md
grep -n -i -A12 '## Navigation' references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -i 'peer' references/package-routing.md | head -20
sed -n '1,120p' rules/hallucination-traps.md
sed -n '120,373p' rules/hallucination-traps.md
sed -n '1,140p' references/theming.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version 2>&1 | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation peerDependencies 2>&1; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@7 version 2>&1 | tail -2; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version 2>&1; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@latest dependencies 2>&1 | head -30

cd /tmp && for u in https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; do curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "$u"; done; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null; echo; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@7 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@7 version 2>/dev/null | tail -1); do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@$v peerDependencies 2>/dev/null; done; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@7.x peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | tail -12

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.2.0 @bem-react/classname@^1.6.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown env' | tail -15; echo "== versions"; for p in navigation icons uikit; do node -p "'$p '+require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; done; node -p "require('./node_modules/@bem-react/classname/package.json').version"; echo "== docs"; curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/nav7.txt -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/navigation/7/llms.txt; head -5 /tmp/nav7.txt
cat /tmp/nav7.txt

grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'ThemeProvider\|useThemeValue\|useTheme\b' /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -80; echo; echo "== localdocs"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && ls -R | head -30; wc -l components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n '1,140p' components/AsideHeader.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -rn "export.*useTheme\b\|export.*useThemeValue\|export.*ThemeProvider\|export type Theme\b\|export type Theme =" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find build -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "useThemeValue" | head -3; cd ../icons && ls; node -e "const i=require('./package.json');console.log(i.main,i.exports&&Object.keys(i.exports).slice(0,5))"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && ls esm | head -30; f=$(grep -rl "menuItems" esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5); echo "$f"; grep -n "menuItems\|renderContent\|footerItems\|headerDecoration\|compact\|onChangeCompact\|logo\|interface AsideHeaderProps\|renderFooter\|MenuItem\b" esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader && ls; grep -n "" types.d.ts | sed -n '1,200p' | grep -v "^\s*[0-9]*:\s*$" | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components && grep -n -A14 "export interface MenuItem\b\|export interface LogoProps\|export type MenuItem\b" types.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -rn "RenderContentType" Content/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn -A6 "export type RenderContentType" Content/ | head -12; echo ----; grep -n -A8 "export interface FooterItemProps\|export interface FooterItem" AsideHeader/components/*.d.ts Footer/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls Footer; echo ----; grep -rn "export" AsideHeader/index.d.ts ../index.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem && ls; cat FooterItem.d.ts | head -60; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json');console.log(p.exports['.']?.types||p.types)"; grep -n "view\|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/ 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && for c in Switch/Switch Checkbox/Checkbox TextInput/TextInput Card/Card Text/Text; do echo "=== $c"; grep -v "^\s*\*\|/\*\*" $c.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -40; done 2>&1 | head -150; grep -n "ButtonView\b =\|ButtonSize\b =" -A3 Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -rn "Text\b.*variant\|TextVariant" Text/*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "ControlProps" -A12 components/types.d.ts | head -30; ls components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rln "export declare const TextInput" components | head -2; grep -n "export.*ThemeProvider\|export" index.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -v "^\s*\*\|/\*\*\|^\s*$" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -30; echo ===; grep -v "^\s*\*\|/\*\*\|^\s*$" SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -30; echo ===; grep -n "export" layout/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "export declare const Flex\|export interface FlexProps" -A3 layout/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -A12 types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "onUpdate" controls/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "BaseInputControlProps" -A6 controls/types.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "footerItems" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -2; grep -n "export interface BoxProps\|spacing" layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "tsc exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -15; echo "vite exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "tsc exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -E "built in|error" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short; echo "--- package.json deps:"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').dependencies,null,1)"
